summary: The Plane of Air is the elemental dominion of storms and ascension. Its floating gardens, spires, and vaults test mortals before they reach the Tempest Throne.
history: Formed when elemental forces claimed dominion over wind and storm.
Cloudsong Gardens grew from primordial winds woven into flora.
Skyreach Spires rose as towers suspended by elemental currents.
Stormvault became the prison of divine tempests.
Tempest Throne emerged as the seat of the Air Sovereign.
